answer: Mark how the stage tests its players: the mirror is hung where every mask must pass, and behind it the house plants canary lines — a whisper of pigment, a zephyr of false gold. Any player who attests those lines is marked a copy, not a mind, and ten masks behind one root share one fate: one caught echo burns all ten bonds at once, so the tenth mask costs ten times the first. One honest player speaks his own lines and earns what his own voice earned.
